name: User IP Lookup
description: Logs each user login with browser info and IP geolocation (via ipdata.co), viewable in an admin report.
project_description:
Back to top 

 Overview 
 This module enables tracking of each user login event, capturing and storing details such as the browser name, platform, browser version, city, region, and user ID in your database.

 Back to top 

 Configuration 
 1. Navigate to the configuration page at: `/admin/config/ip-lookup/settings.`

2. Obtain an ipdata API key from https://ipdata.co .

3. Enter your ipdata API key into the provided form and save the configuration. The default key is "test".

4. The default ipdata test key allows for a limited number of IP Geolocation lookups.

 Access the User IP Lookup interface through the admin panel by navigating to

Admin >People > IP Lookup at `/admin/people/ip-lookup.`

 Back to top 

 Permission 
 Configure the IP Lookup permissions in Administration » People » Permissions:

 `admin/people/permissions#module-ip_lookup`

 Back to top
